title: NASA tries to replicate Podkletnov's weight loss effect

tellings.quote: NASA had exhibited, weirdly, an interest in anti-gravity in the sort of mid-1990s following reports that a guy He was a Russian called a Yevgeny Podkletnov

plain: In the mid-1990s NASA took an interest in anti-gravity and tried to reproduce an effect reported by a Russian scientist named Yevgeny Podkletnov, who worked at the University of Tampere in Finland and claimed objects lost weight near his equipment. The researcher Nick Cook tells Michels this without naming a source, saying NASA "had exhibited, weirdly, an interest in anti-gravity" after those reports. If true, it would mean the space agency took a fringe claim of cancelling gravity seriously enough to test it.
